```{r}
#Description of the models is here:

library(foreign)
library(tidyverse)
library(lattice)
library(lcsm)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

#ID 2561 was on two rows.  It seems very clear that this should only have been one row.  
dat <- read.csv("/Users/gregorymatthews/Dropbox/bohnert_sleep/CL_OTR_COI_Data.csv")
```

# Data Cleaning and EDA
 - Observation ID 2561 had two rows in the data set.  I removed one of these rows.  

```{r}
#EDA
#ID 2561 is a problem
#dat %>% group_by(ID) %>% summarize(n = n()) %>% arrange(-n)
dat %>% filter(ID == 2561) %>% select(RecordedDate, ID, age.v1, gender.v1)

#Remove ID's that are NA
dat <- dat %>% filter(!is.na(ID))

#ID 2561 has two rows
#Fixing this here: 
dat[dat$ID == 2561 &
      is.na(dat$age.v1), c("age.v1", "age_dichotomous", "gender.v1")] <- 
  dat[dat$ID == 2561 & !is.na(dat$age.v1), c("age.v1", "age_dichotomous", "gender.v1")]
dat <- dat[dat$ID != 2561 |
             (dat$ID == 2561 & !is.na(dat$RecordedDate)), ]

#Convert gender 1/2 to male/female
dat <- dat %>% mutate(
  gender.v1 = case_when(gender.v1 == 1 ~ "male", gender.v1 == 2 ~ "female"),
  pdsMF.v1 = case_when(pdsMF.v1 == 1 ~ "male", pdsMF.v1 == 2 ~ "female")
)


```


##  Summary stats


```{r}
dat %>% summarize(
  mean_age = mean(age.v1, na.rm = T),
  pct_female = mean(pdsMF.v1 == "female", na.rm = T),
  mean_income = mean(income.v1, na.rm = T)
)

#ggplots for age and income
ggplot(aes(x = age.v1), data = dat) + geom_bar() + theme_bw()
ggplot(aes(x = age.v1, fill = pdsMF.v1), data = dat %>% filter(pdsMF.v1 %in% c("male","female"))) + geom_bar() + theme_bw() + facet_grid( pdsMF.v1 ~ 1)

ggplot(aes(x = income.v1), data = dat) + geom_histogram() + theme_bw() + geom_vline(aes(xintercept = median(dat$income, na.rm = TRUE)), color = "red") + ggtitle("Red line = Median")

ggplot(aes(x = cg1.edu.deg.v1), data = dat) + geom_bar() + theme_bw()

dat <- dat %>% mutate(cg1_edu_grp = factor(
  case_when(
    cg1.edu.deg.v1 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ "<=HS",
    cg1.edu.deg.v1 %in% c(4, 5, 6) ~ "<=BS",
    cg1.edu.deg.v1 %in% c(7, 8) ~ ">=MS"
  )
))

dat <- dat %>% mutate(cg1_edu_grp = fct_relevel(cg1_edu_grp, c("<=HS", "<=BS", ">=MS")))
ggplot(aes(x = cg1_edu_grp), data = dat) + geom_bar() + theme_bw()

ggplot(aes(x = cg1_edu_grp, fill = pdsMF.v1), data = dat %>% filter(pdsMF.v1 %in% c("male","female"))) + geom_bar() + theme_bw() + facet_grid( pdsMF.v1 ~ 1)

#need at least 5 days of actigraph data
table(dat$act_patotaldays)
#254+55+15 = 324

#I get 324
dat %>% filter(act_patotaldays >= 5 ) %>% nrow()

#Reproducing Table 1 stuff
dat %>% filter(act_patotaldays >= 5) %>% group_by(gender.v1) %>% summarize(age = mean(age.v1), n = n())

dat  %>% group_by(gender.v1) %>% summarize(
  age = mean(age.v1),
  n = n(),
  sleep = mean(act_totsleep.min_avg, na.rm = T),
  inbed = mean(act_totinbed.min_avg, na.rm = T),
  onset = mean(act_onset.time.min_d0, na.rm = T),
  eff = mean(act_efficiency_avg, na.rm = T)
)


#Average inbed time is a problem because times are circular
datinbed <- dat %>%
  select(ID, gender.v1, act_inbed.time_d0:act_inbed.time_d8) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("act_inbed.time_d"),
    names_prefix = "act_inbed.time_d",
    names_to = c("day"),
    values_to = "act_inbed_time"
  ) %>% mutate(act_inbed_time_numeric = as.numeric(do.call(rbind, strsplit(act_inbed_time, ":"))[, 1]) + as.numeric(do.call(rbind, strsplit(act_inbed_time, ":"))[, 2]) / 60,
               inbed.time_angle = 2*pi*act_inbed_time_numeric/24, 
               inbed.time_angle_x = cos(inbed.time_angle) ,
               inbed.time_angle_y = sin(inbed.time_angle),
               ) 

datweekend_yn <- dat %>%
  select(ID, act_weekday_yn_d0:act_weekday_yn_d8) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("act_weekday_yn_d"),
    names_to = c("day"),
    values_to = "act_weekday_yn",
    names_prefix = "act_weekday_yn_d",
  ) 

datinbed <- datinbed %>% left_join(datweekend_yn, by = c("ID","day"))

datinbedmean <- datinbed %>% group_by(gender.v1) %>% summarize(mean_x = mean(inbed.time_angle_x, na.rm = T),
mean_y = mean(inbed.time_angle_y, na.rm = T),n = n()) %>% mutate(mean_angle = atan(mean_y/mean_x),mean_time = mean_angle/(2*pi)*24, mean_x_uc = cos(mean_angle),  mean_y_uc = sin(mean_angle))

datinbedmean
ggplot(
  aes(
    x = inbed.time_angle_x,
    y = -inbed.time_angle_y,
    color = as.factor(gender.v1)
  ),
  data = datinbed %>% filter(gender.v1 %in% c("male", "female"))
) + geom_point(alpha = 0.05, size = 2) + coord_fixed() + facet_grid( ~ gender.v1) + geom_point(
  aes(x = mean_x_uc, y = -mean_y_uc),
  color = "red",
  data = datinbedmean %>% filter(gender.v1 %in% c("male", "female"))
) + geom_segment(x = 0,
                 y = 0,
                 xend = 1,
                 yend = 0) + geom_text(x = 0.5, y = 0.1, label = "0:00") + 
   geom_segment(x = 0,
                 y = 0,
                 xend = -1,
                 yend = 0) + geom_text(x = -0.5, y = 0.1, label = "12:00") + 
  geom_segment(x = 0,
               y = 0,
               xend = 0,
               yend = -1) + geom_text(x = 0.1, y = -0.5, label = "06:00", angle = -90) + 
  geom_segment(x = 0,
               y = 0,
               xend = 0,
               yend = 1) + geom_text(x = 0.1, y = 0.5, label = "18:00", angle = 90)

datlong_resp <- dat %>%
  filter(act_patotaldays >= 5 & gender.v1 %in% c("male","female")) %>%
  select(
    ID,
    RecordedDate,
    pdsMF.v1,
    cg1.age.v1,

    cg1_edu_grp,
    z_COI_nat,

              z_ED_SP_nat),

    names_to = c(".value","day"),

  )


datlong_weekday_yn <- dat %>% 
  filter(act_patotaldays >=5 & gender.v1 %in% c("male","female") ) %>% 
  select(ID, pdsMF.v1, cg1.age.v1,income.v1,cg1.edu.deg.v1, act_weekday_yn_d0:act_weekday_yn_d8) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("act_weekday_yn_d"), names_prefix = "act_weekday_yn_d",names_to = c("day"), values_to = "weekday_yn") 


#Weekend indicator should be Fri/Sat instead of a weekend (Sat/Sun) indicator
datlong <- datlong_resp %>% left_join(datlong_weekday_yn %>% select(ID,day,weekday_yn), by = c("ID","day"))
datlong <- datlong %>% group_by(ID) %>% mutate(I_frisat =  1 - lead(weekday_yn))
datlong <- datlong %>% group_by(ID) %>% mutate(I_frisat = ifelse(is.na(I_frisat),lag(I_frisat,7),I_frisat))
```

# Models 
## Total Sleep

```{r}
ggplot(aes(x = day, y = act_totsleep.min, group = ID, color = pdsMF.v1), data = datlong %>% filter(pdsMF.v1 %in% c("male","female"))) + geom_line(alpha = 0.05)  + theme_bw() + facet_grid(~pdsMF.v1)
```

```{r}
library(lme4)
################################
#act_totalsleep.min
################################
################################
#Model 1: COI Total
################################
mod1_totsleep <- lmer(act_totsleep.min ~ pdsMF.v1 + cg1.age.v1 + I(income.v1/10000) + cg1_edu_grp + I_frisat + z_COI_nat + (1|ID)  , data = datlong)
summary(mod1_totsleep)
confint(mod1_totsleep)

plot(mod1_totsleep, type=c("p","smooth"), col.line=1)

plot(mod1_totsleep,
     sqrt(abs(resid(.)))~fitted(.),
     type=c("p","smooth"), col.line=1)

lattice::qqmath(mod1_totsleep)


################################
#Model 2: COI Sub-domains
################################

mod2_totsleep <- lmer(act_totsleep.min ~ pdsMF.v1 + cg1.age.v1 + I(income.v1/10000) + cg1_edu_grp +  I_frisat + z_ED_nat +  z_HE_nat + z_SE_nat + (1|ID)  , data = datlong)
summary(mod2_totsleep)
confint(mod2_totsleep)

plot(mod2_totsleep, type=c("p","smooth"), col.line=1)

plot(mod2_totsleep,
     sqrt(abs(resid(.)))~fitted(.),
     type=c("p","smooth"), col.line=1)

lattice::qqmath(mod2_totsleep)


################################
#Model 3: COI Sub-domains
################################
mod3_totsleep <- lmer(act_totsleep.min ~ pdsMF.v1 + cg1.age.v1 + I(income.v1/10000) + cg1_edu_grp + z_ED_EC_nat + z_ED_EL_nat + z_ED_ER_nat + z_ED_SP_nat + (1|ID)  , data = datlong)
summary(mod3_totsleep)
confint(mod3_totsleep)
plot(mod3_totsleep, type=c("p","smooth"), col.line=1)

plot(mod3_totsleep,
     sqrt(abs(resid(.)))~fitted(.),
     type=c("p","smooth"), col.line=1)

lattice::qqmath(mod3_totsleep)
```
